## 4. Constitution/dependency consistency

### PASS — Workflow First

`plan.md` defines one explicit bounded graph and guards. `tasks.md` does not create a second free-agent orchestration loop.

### PASS — Provider neutrality

Domain and workflow public structures are project-owned; concrete provider implementations live under `plugins`. T003 includes import-boundary tests.

### PASS — Knowledge engineering separation

No Feature task adds document ingestion/OCR/chunking/vector indexing. Knowledge is consumed through a contract.

### PASS — Durable execution

Business state, queue and checkpoint responsibilities remain separate. T007/T008 explicitly test duplicates, stale writers, checkpoint/business mismatch and restart/resume.

### PASS — Customer-target read-only

Capability effect is a first-class field; T003/T012 require provider invocation count to remain zero for forbidden WRITE/UNKNOWN actions.

### PASS — Evidence/answer quality

Product/version facts require applicable Evidence; unsupported claims fail AnswerCheck. Generic stable direct answer remains allowed without fake citations.

## 5. Findings

### Critical

### High

### Medium

**M01 — Exact third-party package versions are not preselected in design.**  
Disposition: ACCEPTED IMPLEMENTATION TASK. T001 performs a real compatibility probe and commits exact lock files before substantial business code. The component families/major runtime baseline are already frozen. Inventing untested exact versions in a GitHub-only design would be less reliable than this explicit first implementation task.

**M02 — Real Dify/model/DingTalk/read-only provider integration is not implemented in this Feature.**  
Disposition: ACCEPTED SCOPE. The repository requirement says V1 must ultimately contain real integrations, but the first foundation Feature may use Fake external providers for deterministic control tests. `spec.md` and checklists prohibit treating this as full V1 acceptance.

**M03 — `feature/003-support-foundation` is stacked on the still-open `feature/002-support-agent-baseline`, not current main.**  
Disposition: ACCEPTED SOURCE CONTROL STATE. The latest reviewed design exists on 002. The 003 PR should target 002 until PR #2 is merged; afterward its base can be retargeted to main without rebuilding the Feature.

**M04 — Token-by-token final answer streaming is intentionally absent.**  
Disposition: ACCEPTED SECURITY/SCOPE DECISION. Foundation streams safe task progress only and publishes checked answer content. This closes the known draft-leak risk; richer streaming may be a later Feature with chunk-level policy checks.

### Low

**L01 — Exact LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpointer distribution/import package name may differ by compatible release.**  
Disposition: T001 must use the official compatible package, lock it and document the selected import; this is not an architectural choice.

**L02 — The first migration may be one or two revisions.**  
Disposition: `plan.md` allows two only if both leave a startable/testable system; no semantic ambiguity exists.
